'''Template:RTC''' is a version of Template:RT with background color set to black and a foreground to gray to minimize the number of bytes it uses. See [[:Template:RT]] for usage notes and examples.

== Usage ==

<pre><nowiki>
{{RTC|<character>}}
</nowiki></pre>
